class Optional {
  #amount?: number;
  #label?: string;
  amount() { return this.#amount.toFixed(); }
  label(): string { return this.#label; }
}
class Early {
  #first = this.#second;
  #second = 1;
  static #firstStatic = Early.#secondStatic;
  static #secondStatic = 2;
}
const independent = { add(this: void, number: number) { return number + 1; } };
independent.add.call({}, 3);
